profile.title: Strategy profile
profile.description: How this strategy orchestrates — trigger lanes, states, roles, required capabilities, and declared signals.
profile.lanesDescription: How this preset can fire, read from its profile with the locked trigger-lane vocabulary. No next-run value is produced, so none is shown.
profile.laneCronDetail: Per-Work cron with roles (brainstorm / write / review) and timezone — not the wall-clock poller.
profile.laneWallClockDetail: Wall-clock poller: daemon schedule admission on a tick, no cron recurrence. `scheduled_at` is a schedule field, not a next-fire clock.
profile.laneSessionDetail: An event the integrator or product fires — embedded and system presets load at session start.
profile.laneDirectDetail: An event the integrator or product fires — schedule start with an explicit run payload. Not a delivered webhook named in preset signals.
profile.unavailableDescription: The profile for {{name}} could not be loaded.
profile.unavailableListed: The preset is still listed in the catalog.
profile.statesDescription: The outer state machine — enter actions, exit conditions, and next transitions.
profile.rolesDescription: Multi-agent roles and their recommended skills.
profile.capabilitiesDescription: Capabilities this strategy requires — browse the schema in the capability registry.
profile.signalsDescription: Signal names parsed from the preset manifest — declared, not delivered. Nothing fires them at runtime and they are not bindable webhooks; each action is what the preset would do on receive. Lifecycle control runs through the signal actions: start / pause / resume / cancel / advance.
